# Threads Code Saver (threads-embedded-code)
> Lightweight pure front-end browser extension built on Google Chrome Extensions Manifest V3 for automatically capturing, sanitizing, managing, previewing, and exporting structured code snippets and metadata from Threads posts.

## Core Metadata
- Project Name: Threads Code Saver
- Current Version: 2.0.5
- Specification: Google Chrome Extensions Manifest V3
- Tech Stack: Pure Native JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 Custom Properties (Zero external dependencies, zero compilation/build step)
- Data Persistence: Browser local storage (chrome.storage.local, 10MB quota, 100% offline, privacy-first)
- License: MIT ([LICENSE](./LICENSE))
- Source Repository: https://github.com/Scorpio-meow/threads-embedded-code
- Companion Showcase Repository: https://github.com/Scorpio-meow/Threads-Featured-Posts (Consumes exported featured post data as its primary dataset)

## Core Files
- manifest.json: Extension configuration manifest declaring Manifest V3 specs, permissions (storage, tabs, scripting), host matches, and strict CSP headers.
- content.js: Primary Content Script handling Threads DOM mutation observation, embed dialog weighted scoring, top-level text container extraction, image-only description filtering, and 25+ UI/timestamp noise regex cleaners.
- styles.css: Injected floating notification styles displayed on Threads web pages.
- popup.html: 400px width browser toolbar popup markup structure.
- popup.css: Toolbar popup stylesheet featuring dark theme tokens and responsive card lists.
- popup.js: Toolbar popup controller supporting real-time keyword search, 6 sorting rules, 6 filter categories (including no-content filtering), single-item maintenance, and quick export.
- dashboard.html: Full-page management dashboard markup including the Live Preview modal, statistical clouds, batch action toolbar, and custom confirmation modals.
- dashboard.css: Dashboard stylesheet containing CSS Grid cards, device frame switcher, and transition animations.
- dashboard.js: Dashboard core controller managing the Live Preview modal, sequential asynchronous update queue (with pause/resume/cancel signals), Top 15 tag/author clouds, batch operations, and custom non-blocking confirmation dialogs.
- favicon.png: 128x128 extension icon asset.
- README.md: Comprehensive Traditional Chinese technical documentation with Mermaid diagrams, schemas, and developer guide.
- llms.txt: Structured technical specifications for AI agents and LLM/RAG indexing pipelines.

## Data Models & Schema
All post records are stored as an array of SavedArticle objects within the `savedArticles` key in `chrome.storage.local`.

### SavedArticle Interface
```typescript
interface SavedArticle {
  /** Unique primary identifier (format: embed_[timestamp]_[random] or code_[timestamp]_[random]) */
  id: string;

  /** Canonical Threads post URL, used as unique key for deduplication and updates */
  postLink: string;

  /** Official Threads native <blockquote> embed HTML code */
  embedCode: string;

  /** Publication timestamp in ISO 8601 standard format */
  timestamp: string;

  /** Formatted publication title string (e.g., "May 29, 2026, 10:00 AM") */
  timestampTitle: string;

  /** Local storage timestamp in ISO 8601 format */
  savedAt: string;

  /** Sanitized plaintext content preserving natural paragraph line breaks */
  content: string;

  /** Author username handle including @ prefix (e.g., "@username") */
  author: string;

  /** Author's Threads profile page URL */
  authorUrl: string;

  /** Array of extracted hashtags and keyword tags */
  tags: string[];

  /** Array of parsed code block items */
  codeBlocks: CodeBlock[];

  /** Total count of identified code blocks */
  codeCount: number;

  /** Post operational status */
  status: 'active' | 'expired';

  /** Timestamp of the last background update check (ISO 8601) */
  lastUpdated?: string;

  /** Timestamp when the post was marked as expired (ISO 8601) */
  expiredAt?: string;

  /** Specific reason for expiration */
  expiredReason?: 'redirected' | 'post-not-found' | 'fallback-summary';

  /** Timestamp of the last status check attempt (ISO 8601) */
  expiredCheckedAt?: string;

  /** Timestamp when publication timestamp was last updated (ISO 8601) */
  timestampUpdatedAt?: string;

  /** Source format indicator when imported */
  importedFrom?: 'full-data-file' | 'js-embed-file';
}
```

### CodeBlock Interface
```typescript
interface CodeBlock {
  /** Source classification of the code snippet */
  type: 'markdown_block' | 'html_tag' | 'monospace' | 'inline';

  /** Extracted code text */
  code: string;

  /** Inferred programming language ("unknown" if undetected) */
  language: string;

  /** 1-based sequential index within the post */
  index: number;

  /** Count of inline code tokens (only applicable for inline type) */
  count?: number;
}
```

## Key Concepts & Algorithms

### 1. Top-Level Text Container Layout Extraction
- Targets primary content nodes: `span[class*="xo1l8bm"][dir="auto"]`, `span[class*="xi7mnp6"][dir="auto"]`, and `div[class*="x1iorvi4"][dir="auto"]`.
- Strictly ignores `time` tags, permalink tags (`a[href*="/post/"]`, `a[href*="/t/"]`), author header links (`a[href*="/@"]`), and Meta AI promotional text.
- Applies `isLikelyImageOnlyDescription` heuristic to filter out media captions.
- Deduplicates containers hierarchically and invokes `innerText.trim()`, preserving paragraph breaks and `<br>` elements without whitespace collapse.

### 2. Embed Dialog Weighted Scoring Algorithm
- Scans all readonly input fields within the embed modal and scores candidates:
  - Base string length score
  - Contains `data-text-post-permalink`: +1000 points
  - Contains `<blockquote`: +500 points
  - Contains `threads.com`: +100 points
- Selects the highest-scoring candidate to ensure 100% complete blockquote retrieval.

### 3. Multimodal Code Block Detection
- Markdown fenced code blocks: Matches `/```(\w*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g` and captures declared language identifiers.
- HTML pre/code tags: Captures nodes with text length greater than 5 characters.
- Monospace font blocks: Captures elements with `style*="monospace"` declarations.
- Inline code: Matches `/`([^`\n]{2,})`/g` and combines tokens into an inline code record.

### 4. 25+ Regex Noise & Timestamp Filtering Pipeline
- Cleaners strip translation buttons, carousel counters (e.g., 1/5), relative timestamps (e.g., "2d", "1h", "just now", "yesterday"), follower metrics, thread counts, and navigation items across multiple UI locales.

### 5. Live Preview Protocol & Dynamic Height Adaptation
- Dual-tab interface supporting Official Embed preview and Raw Source/Metadata inspection.
- Device width presets: 658px (Official default), 480px (Tablet), 320px (Mobile), and 100% (Responsive fluid).
- Keyboard navigation: ESC to close, Left Arrow / Right Arrow for previous/next post navigation.
- Cross-origin height adaptation: Listens for `window.message` events with `type: 'MEASURE'` strictly validating origin against allowed domains (`threads.net`, `threads.com`, `instagram.com`).

### 6. Background Sequential Update Queue
- Orders update tasks based on current UI filter and sort state.
- Executes updates sequentially inside a single hidden tab to eliminate rate limiting or high CPU usage.
- Supports pause, resume, and cancellation signals.
- Automatically marks posts as expired upon redirect or post-not-found (404/deleted), and restores them to active once accessible.

### 7. 6 Filter Dimensions & 6 Sorting Rules
- Filter Categories:
  - `all`: All stored posts
  - `author`: Filter by specific author handle
  - `tag`: Filter by specific hashtag/topic
  - `noContent`: Posts without text body (pure code, images, or empty descriptions)
  - `noTimestamp`: Posts lacking timestamp or requiring synchronization
  - `expired`: Deleted, privatized, or redirected posts
- Sorting Rules:
  - `savedAt-desc` / `savedAt-asc`: Saved time Newest / Oldest
  - `timestamp-desc` / `timestamp-asc`: Publish time Newest / Oldest
  - `author-asc` / `author-desc`: Author handle A-Z / Z-A

## Export & Import Specifications

### Export Formats
1. Embed Only: `threads-embed-codes-YYYY-MM-DD.js`
   ```javascript
   const posts = [
       '<blockquote class="text-post-media" data-text-post-permalink="...">...</blockquote>'
   ];
   ```
2. Featured Data: `threads-featured-data-YYYY-MM-DD.js` (Formatted for Threads-Featured-Posts; author without @ prefix)
   ```javascript
   const posts = [
       {
           "embedCode": "...",
           "postLink": "https://www.threads.com/@user/post/...",
           "author": "user",
           "content": "...",
           "tags": ["JavaScript"]
       }
   ];
   ```
3. Full Backup Data: `threads-full-data-YYYY-MM-DD.js` (Complete SavedArticle fields)
   ```javascript
   const posts = [
       {
           "embedCode": "...",
           "postLink": "https://www.threads.com/@user/post/...",
           "author": "@user",
           "content": "...",
           "timestamp": "2026-05-29T02:00:00.000Z",
           "timestampTitle": "May 29, 2026, 10:00 AM",
           "savedAt": "2026-05-29T02:10:00.000Z",
           "tags": ["JavaScript"],
           "status": "active"
       }
   ];
   ```

### Import Pipeline
- Three-stage resilient parser: `JSON.parse` -> dynamic evaluation via `new Function` -> token-based regular expression extraction.
- Modes: Merge (Deduplicates based on postLink) or Overwrite (Replaces entire database).

## Security & Content Security Policy (CSP)
- Permissions: `storage`, `tabs`, `scripting`
- Host Permissions: `https://www.threads.com/*`, `https://threads.com/*`, `https://www.threads.net/*`, `https://threads.net/*`
- CSP Headers: `script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.threads.com https://www.threads.net https://*.threads.com https://*.threads.net;` (No inline scripts, no remote CDN scripts)
- PostMessage Security: Strict origin checking on incoming iframe resize messages.
- XSS Prevention: Safe text node rendering (`textContent` and `innerText`) for user-controlled strings in dashboard preview metadata.

## Development & Local Testing
- Pure front-end extension with zero build steps and zero local server requirements.
- Clone repository and navigate to `chrome://extensions/` in Chromium-based browsers.
- Enable **Developer Mode** in the top right.
- Click **Load unpacked** and select the project root directory.
